what: Contract data the geometry doesn't carry (br-bwju.3): mass split, hinges, collider kinds, anchors and LOD budgets. Pivots come from the model (model.js pivots()); the bake joins the two into au-hawk.asset.json. The Cruz Missile's hinge layout (plan §6.3): doors 0-70 degrees about the front edge, front (nose, bonnet, teardrop lamps, oval grille, bumper) and back (boot, wrap-around tail lamps, winged spoiler, bumper) hang about their top edges, wheels +-6 degrees camber. +X is the car's left.

anchorNotes.cam_fp: Driver's eye: right-hand drive, so the car's right (-X).
anchorNotes.roof_number: On the roof crown, midway along the painted roof (stations z 0.06 and -0.41, crown 1.64).
anchorNotes.lplate_front: On the bumper below the oval grille.
anchorNotes.lplate_rear: On the boot lid's lower edge between the tail lamps.

colliderExclude.core: The mirrors: decoration (model.js decor), not a collision surface, so the hull stays the body's width.

triBudgetOverride.why: br-bwju.12 round 2, measured: a minimal vision model names the AU an AU Falcon from the bar views at LOD0 (14 of 15 calls) but at LOD1 (888 tris) and LOD2 (596) about 12 % of calls; LOD1 at 1442 tris with LOD0's round body was named one about three times as often. The far tiers need the tumblehome and domed deck. Host cost: docs/evidence/P1-V-au-hawk/render.json.
